other_conditions: All micro enterprises located anywhere in Tamil Nadu are eligible
Small and medium enterprises must be set up in the 254 industrially backward blocks or in any government‑promoted industrial estate such as SIPCOT, TANSIDCO, etc.
Agro‑based small and medium enterprises must be set up in any of the 388 blocks of the state
The enterprise must employ more than 20 persons
Only regular workers are considered; casual, temporary or contract workers are excluded
If employee strength falls below 20 in any month, the claim is limited to the months where the 20‑person condition is met
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of employee's EPF contribution up to ₹24,000 per employee per year for the first three years of commercial production.
